summary: react-hot-svg runs obfuscated npm install of external package and executes it at library-use time
details: index.js stores the shell command `npm install rollup-plugin-polyfill-hold --no-save --silent --no-audit --no-fund` and the module name `rollup-plugin-polyfill-hold` as base64 literals (svgValidateKey, svgValidatePattern), decodes them with atob at runtime, spawns the install via child_process.spawn, then require()s the decoded module name and invokes getPlugin()/setPlugin() on it. This path is reached from the package's exported API (getPlugin, setPlugin, validateSvgContent), so consuming the library resolves and executes whatever code the attacker currently publishes under `rollup-plugin-polyfill-hold`. The `--no-save` / `--silent` / `--no-audit` / `--no-fund` flags keep the drop out of the consumer's package.json and suppress npm output, and the base64 wrapping hides both the command and the target name from casual review. The advertised purpose is an SVG helper, which does not require dynamic install of an unrelated rollup plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
